0.description: A rookie on the rise with razor-sharp claws─the ferocious feline Black Cat!

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07010_000030_METEM
2.description: The match is decided! Victory goes to the challenger!

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07010_000040_METEM
3.description: The starlet with a sting─the adorable-but-deadly, sweet-but-poisonous Honey B. Lovely!

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07010_000050_METEM
4.description: Tonight he explodes in the ring once more... The man you love to hate with a fiery passion─the Brute Bomber!

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07010_000060_METEM
5.description: Wielding both magic and machina, she's a witch for a new age. The wondrous Wicked Thunder!

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07010_000070_WICKEDTHUNDER
6.description: Damn it... No choice but to withdraw.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_07010_000080_METEM
7.description: In a shocking turn of events, Wicked Thunder has fled the ring! Our unstoppable upstart is victorious!
